variant_decisions.evidence: ASV main text 'Let death come suddenly upon them' renders the qere יַשִּׁי מָוֶת (jussive of נשׁא + 'death'); the ketiv ישימות 'desolations' would give 'Desolations be upon them', which the ASV prints only as the marginal 'as otherwise read' alternative, not in the text. The wording itself decides; the alternative_rendering note is not relied on.
